newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Russian guards kill three on Tajik-Afghan border.
newsitem.headline: Russian guards kill three on Tajik-Afghan border.

text.p: Russian border guards shot dead three people trying to cross into Tajikistan from neighbouring Afghanistan late on Sunday, a Russian military spokesman said on Monday.

The spokesman for the border troops, speaking from the Tajik capital Dushanbe, said the three had tried to cross the Pyandzh river, which marks part of the border in the south of the country, in an inflatable dinghy.
It was the second incident in just two days. Three people were shot late on Friday and a border guards spokesman said they were trying to smuggle drugs into Tajikistan.
Around 20,000 Russian peacekeepers and border guards serve in Tajikistan in agreement with Dushanbe. They view themselves as a block to militant Islam spreading northwards from Afghanistan.

But despite a ceasefire agreed last December between the government and the Islamist opposition, which halted a four-year civil war, Tajikistan remains unsettled and armed bands and drug traffickers continue to operate from bases inside Afghanistan.
